import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

started = time.perf_counter()
root = Path.cwd()
target_path = Path('tests/experiments/candidates/capability_bound_semantic_currentness/omrc_b01/test_initial_train_episode.py')
edit_path = Path('temp/directions/capability_bound_semantic_currentness/test/p47_projection_20260908_control/edit_prefix.py')
before = (Path(__file__).parent / 'original_test.py.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
current = (root / target_path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
edit = (root / edit_path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
ast.parse(before)
edit_tree = ast.parse(edit)
assert [n.module for n in ast.walk(edit_tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom)] == ['pathlib']
assert not any(isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.For, ast.While)) for n in ast.walk(edit_tree))
calls = [n for n in ast.walk(edit_tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)]
assert {ast.unparse(n.func) for n in calls if not isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) or n.func.attr != 'replace'} == {'Path', 'p.read_text', 'p.write_text'}
assert [ast.literal_eval(n.args[0]) for n in calls if isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == 'Path'] == [target_path.as_posix()]
replacements = sorted((n for n in calls if isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == 'replace'), key=lambda n: (n.lineno, n.col_offset, n.end_col_offset))
reconstructed = before
for node in replacements:
    assert len(node.args) == 2 and not node.keywords
    old, new = map(ast.literal_eval, node.args)
    assert isinstance(old, str) and isinstance(new, str)
    assert reconstructed.count(old) == 1
    reconstructed = reconstructed.replace(old, new)
assert len(replacements) == 6
current_tree = ast.parse(current)
assert ast.dump(ast.parse(reconstructed)) == ast.dump(current_tree)
assert reconstructed == current
main = next(n for n in current_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'main')
ranges = [n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == 'range']
assert len(ranges) == 1 and ast.literal_eval(ranges[0].args[0]) == 52
reference_read = next(n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'retained_prefix_reference.read_bytes')
tuple_call = next(n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'tuple')
assert reference_read.lineno > tuple_call.lineno
research_prefixes = ('torch', 'numpy', 'experiments', 'envs', 'environments', 'ha_ctse_process')
loaded = [name for name in sys.modules if name.split('.')[0] in research_prefixes]
assert loaded == []
print(json.dumps({
    'status': 'PASS_SOURCE_ONLY', 'prior_source': 'd843b5f903663dcc5a699c0a85fbae4e5252d20f',
    'target_path': target_path.as_posix(), 'saved_edit_path': edit_path.as_posix(),
    'source_inputs': 3, 'ast_parses': 4, 'literal_replacements': len(replacements),
    'reconstructed_text_and_ast_equal': True, 'edit_script_executed': False,
    'target_imported_or_executed': False, 'research_modules_loaded': loaded,
    'module_scope_run_import_line': next(n.lineno for n in current_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and n.module.startswith('experiments.')),
    'unexecuted_prefix': {'tapes': 52, 'tokens': 52 * 152, 'pack_calls': 52 * 304, 'final_bytes': 152 * 17},
    'target_invocations': 0, 'research_native_calls': 0, 'environment_tapes': 0,
    'model_calls': 0, 'optimizer_updates': 0, 'score_evaluations': 0,
    'checker_body_wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started,
}))
